PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Security: This hardware is Unclassified at all operations.
Foreign Object Debris (FOD): If FOD is detected, notify the responsible inspector and complete form 99999-XYZ per STD-1200.
General process instruction requirements: STD-1000 STD-1100 STD-1200
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
The following shall be followed at all times by all personnel:
Finger cots or gloves shall be worn when handling hardware.
All screws shall be cleaned and primed before installation.
All tools and gauges shall be clean and calibrated.
Record date and time in the format MM/DD/YY HH:MM.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Obtain one clean ESD kitting tray for the Widget Mount Assembly (DWG-4500-01) per STD-1000.
Place a layer of anti-static foam into the kitting tray.
Verify the tray is free of foreign object debris (FOD) per STD-1200.
Insert the parts listed in the Assembly Parts List into the tray.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Create a license-plate label for each kitted assembly per STD-1300, containing the assembly part number as a 2D barcode, the production order number, and the serial number (see Figure 1).
Attach the license plate to the tray and deliver the completed kit to the assembly area.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Obtain the Bracket (PN-1001). Inspect for dents, cuts, and scratches. If damaged, contact supervision.
If required, clean the Bracket with isopropyl alcohol per STD-1400. Do not immerse. Blow dry.
Clean (do not prime) four (4) setscrews (PN-1007). Install the four setscrews into the bracket cavities using a 2.5 mm hex key until snug, then back them out five (5) full turns.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Place four (4) adhesive-backed EMI gaskets (PN-1002) onto the bracket flanges as shown; center each gasket over the opening. Alignment fixture FIX-2200 may be used.
Clean and apply threadlocker (Loctite 242) to twenty-two (22) screws (PN-1008) per STD-1500 using Adhesive Grade A (ADH-100-A) or Grade B (ADH-100-B). Record cure time in operator comments.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Place the Network Assembly (PN-1004) onto the skin (PN-1012). Verify orientation by aligning the screw holes.
Install the Network Assembly to the skin using twenty-two (22) screws. Torque screws to 4.0 in-lbs using calibrated torque wrench TOOL-TQ-05.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Install three (3) bullet connectors (PN-1011) to the Housing (PN-1005) using tool TOOL-INS-01 or equivalent.
Loosely attach the two brackets to the Housing using four (4) screws (PN-1009) and four (4) washers (PN-1006). Do not tighten at this time.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Remove the backing from two (2) gaskets. Align and install the two gaskets to the Network Assembly, adhesive side toward the assembly.
Install the Housing to the Network Assembly by aligning the three bullet connectors; press until fully engaged.

Attach the brackets to the Network Assembly using four (4) screws and four (4) washers. Torque these four screws to 6.0 in-lbs, then torque the four previously installed screws to 6.0 in-lbs using torque wrench TOOL-TQ-05.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Connect the assembly to the functional test station per STD-1600.
Record the functional test results in SYS-TRACK.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Apply threadlocker to the four (4) skin setscrews per STD-1500 using Adhesive Grade C (ADH-100-C). Do not prime the screws.
Inspect the assembly for conformance to these work instructions.
Inspect workmanship per STD-1700 and STD-1750. Verify the sealing compound cure time for the tuning screws is recorded in operator comments per STD-1500.
PROPRIETARY — CONTROLLED DISTRIBUTION — See Distribution Statement
Inspect the skin surface finish: gouges and scratches in Zone A shall not exceed 0.060 in. When in doubt, contact the Project Engineer.
